topic.readerProblem: Resolve Waikay’s conflicting Starter prices and calculate whether credits cover a repeatable prompt-model cadence.
topic.connection: Directly supports an AEOeye buyer scoping a recurring AI-answer visibility monitoring program.

assessment: The final guide puts the official US$19.95 versus US$24.95 Starter discrepancy at the center of the buying decision instead of selecting a convenient number. Its credit examples use the published cadence formula and are explicitly planning math, not observed account consumption.
